## Review in VS Code

After this PR is opened, review the diff in VS Code:

1. Install the **GitHub Pull Requests** extension (recommended in `.vscode/extensions.json`).
2. Command Palette → **GitHub Pull Requests: Review Pull Request**.
3. Or open: `https://github.dev/amitsk/learning-shell/pull/<this-number>`
